profile.subtitleJa: アカイアの総督としてコリントの法廷にいたローマの行政官
profile.summaryJa: アカイアの総督としてコリントの法廷にいたローマの行政官。パウロを訴える人々が彼の前に連れて来られた。

facts.textJa: ガリオは訴えを不正や犯罪ではなく、ユダヤ人の律法・言葉をめぐる争いとして扱った。
ソステネが法廷の前で打たれた際、ガリオは介入しなかった。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,
But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;
Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.
